snippet.title: Circulo is OUT NOW on Steam! | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Circulo is officially OUT NOW on Steam!

Enter a fast-paced 2D arena built around geometric chaos. Survive increasingly intense waves, defeat bosses, unlock new forms, abilities and companions, and keep getting stronger through persistent progression.

Built entirely as a solo indie project.

Play Circulo now on Steam!

#Circulo #SoloDev #IndieGame #BulletHell #Roguelite #Steam
